title: Farmers announce indefinite hunger strike in Tirupur for canal water
seoTitle: Tirupur farmers hunger strike for water

tea.why: Farmers in tail-end areas allege they are consistently denied equitable irrigation water under the Parambikulam-Aliyar Project due to theft.
tea.want: Demand equitable water supply to 1,500 tail-end acres, stricter action against water theft, and increased zero-point water levels.
tea.changed: Oct 22: The PAP Vellakovil Branch Canal Water Conservation Association announced plans to launch an indefinite hunger strike starting October 29.

summary: Farmers in the tail-end of the Parambikulam-Aliyar Project (PAP) Main Canal ayacut in Tirupur district have announced an indefinite hunger strike starting October 29. Organised by the PAP Vellakovil Branch Canal (Kangayam-Vellakovil) Water Conservation Association, the protest aims to address persistent water shortages affecting approximately 1,500 acres at the tail-end. Organisers allege that despite higher overall water drawals from the Thirumoorthy Dam and excess withdrawals by upstream branch canals, tail-end supply remains incomplete because authorities fail to crack down on water theft or enforce equitable distribution rules. Their demands include a seven-day rotational supply at each sluice gate, raising the water level at the canal's zero point, and taking legal action against offenders. No official response from authorities regarding the impending strike has been reported yet.
organizers: PAP Vellakovil Branch Canal (Kangayam-Vellakovil) Water Conservation Association
demands: Secure water supply to 1,500 tail-end acres under the Vellakovil branch canal
Take strict legal action and withdraw subsidies from individuals indulging in water theft
Raise the water level at the Vellakovil branch canal zero point from 4.5 ft to 4.8 ft
Implement a seven-day rotational supply at each sluice gate
Enforce the PAP Act 20/1993 and Madras high court directions on equitable water distribution
response: No official response reported in the sources.

updates.text: The PAP Vellakovil Branch Canal Water Conservation Association announced an indefinite hunger strike starting Oct 29 following an inconclusive WRD meeting.
Association president P. Velusamy reiterated plans for the October 29 strike, flaying the Water Resources Department over inaction on upstream water theft.
